note: Midday research - March 11, 2026, 1:00 PM ET. Key new stories: Apple Music/TikTok exclusive partnership (full-song streaming + Listening Party), Bad Bunny wins copyright case, MLC vs Pandora mechanical royalties battle heating up, Reservoir/Hans Zimmer deal, TikTok avoids Canada shutdown. Continuing: Google sued by indie artists over Lyria 3, UK government weighing copyright exception for AI (March 18 deadline), Live Nation DOJ settlement ($280M), Steam sued by UK PRS over game music, ChatGPT now Shazams songs, GEMA vs Suno Munich hearing (copyright precedent).
insightTech: AI music landscape shifting: Suno/Udio settled lawsuits, now paying licensing fees. ElevenLabs enters the race with $500M raise at $11B valuation. Major labels launching licensed AI platforms. Stock music market being commoditized by AI generators. New VSTs (Serum 2, MOSAIQ) still relevant alongside AI tools. Google and Apple now embedding AI music in core apps. Google acquires ProducerAI (formerly Riffusion). Suno hires ex-Merlin CEO Jeremy Sirota as CCO. UNESCO warns 24% income decline for music creators. Cloudflare now lets content owners charge AI crawlers. Apple Music launches AI transparency tags (voluntary). Spain's market up 13.7% (strongest since 2003). GEMA vs Suno case outcome could set precedent for AI music licensing in Europe. ChatGPT now can Shazam songs via Apple integration.
insightStrategy: Musio+ Complete differentiates through bundling real instruments from multiple developers - AI can't replicate authentic human performance. Need visibility push before launch - Musio not appearing in current AI music discussions. Consider press outreach. Artist-led campaigns like 'Say No To Suno' emerging. Major labels partnering with AI companies (UMG + NVIDIA). Suno/Udio now seeking to join industry through licensing deals after lawsuits. Spotify now letting users 'steer algorithm' with AI prompts. UMG reports strong Q4 ($4.19B, +10.6% YoY) - industry remains robust despite AI disruption concerns. GEMA vs Suno case outcome could set precedent for AI music licensing in Europe.

research.title: Apple Music lands exclusive TikTok partnership to bring full-song streaming into social app
research.summary: Apple Music and TikTok announce exclusive partnership allowing full-song streaming within the social app, plus 'Listening Party' feature for real-time fan interaction.

research.title: Bad Bunny beats copyright lawsuit over 'Enséñame a Bailar' sample
research.summary: Producer's copyright claim over 'Un Verano Sin Ti' track ends in dismissal - significant win for the artist.

research.title: The MLC and Pandora clash in opposition briefs as mechanical royalties battle nears decisive stage
research.summary: Both filings landed in US District Court for Middle District of Tennessee as mechanical royalties battle escalates.

research.title: Reservoir strikes worldwide publishing admin deal with Hans Zimmer
research.summary: Reservoir will administer Zimmer's catalog through his company, Remote Control Publishing - expanding relationship with Academy Award-winning composer.

research.title: TikTok avoids shutdown in Canada after security review
research.summary: TikTok will implement 'security gateways and privacy-enhancing technologies' in Canada under new terms, avoiding shutdown.

research.title: Hari Nair to exit as CEO of India's Tips Music
research.summary: Former Sony Music India and ByteDance veteran will exit on April 30.

research.title: Stromae's Mosaert label renews global deal with Warner Chappell Music
research.summary: Renewed agreement keeps WCM as global representative for Stromae's catalog.

research.title: Confirmed: Agent Lucy Dickins to join CAA after exiting WME
research.summary: Dickins will serve on CAA's Managing Director committee and continue working directly with top music artists.

research.title: UK government weighs commercial research exception for AI training on copyrighted music
research.summary: UK government considering copyright exception that could let AI companies train on copyrighted music without permission. Lawmakers face March 18 deadline on copyright reform.

research.title: Indie artists sue Google, claiming YouTube used their catalog to train Lyria 3 AI
research.summary: Independent artists have filed lawsuit against Google alleging YouTube used their music catalog to train Lyria 3 AI model without permission - expanding legal front in AI copyright battles.

research.title: Live Nation confirms details of antitrust settlement with DOJ
research.summary: Live Nation confirms details of antitrust settlement with US Department of Justice. Company set aside $280M for damages claims from states.

research.title: Steam faces legal action from UK's PRS over alleged unlicensed use of music in games
research.summary: Gaming platform Steam sued by UK PRS for Music over alleged unlicensed use of music in games. PRS attempted to reach agreement for many years before issuing legal proceedings on March 4.

research.title: ChatGPT can now Shazam songs as Apple brings music recognition tool to OpenAI's chatbot
research.summary: OpenAI integrates Apple's Shazam music recognition into ChatGPT - users can now identify songs directly through the chatbot. Apple previously integrated Spotify and Apple Music into OpenAI's app ecosystem.

research.title: Universal Music Nordics restructures under 'One Nordic' model
research.summary: Universal Music restructures Nordic operations, unifying units in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Baltics under single 'One Nordic' organizational model.

research.title: GEMA vs. Suno: Landmark AI music copyright case heard in Munich court today
research.summary: Oral proceedings in Munich court in copyright case brought by Germany's GEMA against AI music generator Suno - key test for AI copyright in Europe. Outcome could set precedent for AI music licensing.

research.title: Live Nation settles antitrust battle with DOJ
research.summary: Live Nation reaches settlement with Department of Justice in antitrust battle, according to Politico reports. Company sets aside $280M for damages claims from states.

research.title: Apple Music Introduces Tagging for AI Songs, Its First Regulation on AI Use
research.summary: Apple Music becomes latest platform to introduce AI song tagging - first formal regulation on AI use by the streaming giant. Tags are voluntary for labels and distributors.

research.title: Google's Gemini Launches New AI Music Model, Lyria 3
research.summary: Google's Gemini introduces Lyria 3, its newest AI music generation model - major tech player deepening AI music capabilities.

research.title: beatBread makes run of new appointments, including ex-Spotify and CD Baby execs
research.summary: New hires from CD Baby, Spotify and Countsy bring finance, operations and AI expertise to the music funding company's leadership team.

research.title: AEG International Global Partnerships strengthens leadership team with key promotions
research.summary: Georgina Iceton, Will Dowdy, and Matthew Zweck each promoted to Senior Vice President roles.

research.title: Ed Sheeran's lawyers push to end remaining 'Thinking Out Loud' copyright case
research.summary: Sheeran's legal team argues the copyright registration underpinning the case was never valid.

research.title: Cumulus Media files for bankruptcy to shed $600M in debt
research.summary: US radio broadcaster Cumulus Media files for bankruptcy - second Chapter 11 filing after 2017. Aims to shed $600M in debt.

research.title: HYBE and Spotify strike global content partnership for K-pop video podcasts
research.summary: HYBE will produce original podcast content through its in-house studio, with the first show launching later this month.

research.title: Lucy Dickins, agent for Adele and Mumford & Sons, to exit WME after seven years
research.summary: Long-time Co-Head Kirk Sommer will continue to lead WME's Contemporary Music division. Dickins was a prominent agent in the UK music industry.

research.title: Kobalt inks worldwide sub-publishing and admin deal with UK's Sync Music Global
research.summary: Kobalt will oversee global administration for the independent publisher's catalogue and roster.

research.title: Suicideboys sued in the UK over alleged unauthorized sample
research.summary: Rough Trade and Beggars Music sue Suicideboys over alleged unauthorized sample. The song in question has amassed over 115 million Spotify streams.

research.title: Andrea Czapary Martin to exit as CEO of UK's PRS for Music at end of 2026
research.summary: PRS represents the rights of more than 180,000 songwriters, composers, and music publishers.

research.title: Music industry groups push Senate to tighten TICKET Act, cap resale fees at 10%
research.summary: Fix the Tix also pushes for disclosure of the base ticket price and a prohibition on speculative ticketing.

research.title: Reservoir faces competing takeover proposals from Wesbild and Richmond Hill
research.summary: Shareholders Wesbild and Richmond Hill propose to acquire all outstanding shares of Reservoir at $10.50 per share in cash, countering Irenic Capital bid.

research.title: Idris Elba's indie label 7wallace strikes strategic partnership with Nas
research.summary: Strategic partnership announced between Idris Elba's 7wallace label and Nas.

research.title: Sir Lucian Grainge talks AI strategy, Downtown, D2C, superfans on UMG Q4 call
research.summary: UMG CEO compares Downtown Music acquisition to EMI (2011) - 'one of the most successful and strategically important in music industry history.' Says Downtown will be transformational for UMG's label, publishing and superfan businesses.

research.title: UMG puts US listing plans on hold
research.summary: Universal Music Group has put plans for a US stock listing on hold, according to Q4 earnings call comments.

research.title: UMG generated $4.19B in Q4, up 10.6% YoY
research.summary: Universal Music's Q4 results driven by Taylor Swift, KPop Demon Hunters soundtrack, Olivia Dean and more - strong quarter for major label.

research.title: Robert Kyncl talks Suno, AI, value of music at Morgan Stanley
research.summary: Warner Music Group CEO Robert Kyncl made the case for AI as opportunity at Morgan Stanley conference, following shareholder letter on AI value.

research.title: Spain's recorded music market grew 13.7% in 2025
research.summary: Spain's market strongest since 2003 with subscription streaming revenues up 19.2% YoY, though revenues remain 26% below 2001 peak.

research.title: South Korea's music industry unites against AI copyright infringement
research.summary: Six music rights organizations form coalition declaring 'state of emergency' and 'declaration of war' against AI copyright infringement.

research.title: Create raises $450M at $2.2B Valuation
research.summary: Create Music Group completes $450 million funding round at $2.2 billion valuation - major player in AI music and label services space.

research.title: Spotify paid out $213M to Australian rightsholders in 2025, up 7% YoY
research.summary: Australian listeners streamed domestic artists 223 million more times in 2025 than the year prior - strong growth in local consumption.

research.title: Charlie Puth joins AI music creation platform Moises as Chief Music Officer
research.summary: Grammy-nominated songwriter and producer Charlie Puth joins Moises as CMO to guide creative and product direction.

research.title: Suno and Udio Complete Licensing Deals
research.summary: Suno and Udio have now completed licensing deals with major labels, transitioning from defendants to industry partners.

research.title: ElevenLabs raises $500M at $11B valuation
research.summary: ElevenLabs raised $500M in latest round led by Sequoia Capital, reaching $11B valuation. Major entry into AI music market.

research.title: Spotify to let users 'steer the algorithm' with AI prompts
research.summary: Spotify launching new feature allowing users to personalize playlists with AI prompts.

research.title: Suno hits 2M Paid Subscribers, $300M ARR
research.summary: Suno announces 2 million paid subscribers and $300M annual recurring revenue - major milestone for AI music sector.

research.title: Google buys ProducerAI (formerly Riffusion)
research.summary: Google acquires ProducerAI, strengthening its position in the AI music generation market.

research.title: Artist representatives launch 'Say No To Suno' campaign
research.summary: Campaign against AI music generators, arguing 'AI slop dilutes the royalty pools of legitimate artists.'

research.title: Suno hires ex-Merlin CEO Jeremy Sirota as CCO
research.summary: Suno hires former Merlin CEO Jeremy Sirota to lead commercial strategy.

research.title: Artists face steep income decline due to AI, UNESCO finds
research.summary: Music creators could see revenues fall by 24% due to AI, while audiovisual sector may lose 21%.

research.title: Universal Music + NVIDIA Partnership
research.summary: UMG partnered with NVIDIA to develop AI music discovery and creation tools, pledging 'Antidote' to 'AI Slop'.

research.title: AI Opt-In Is the Floor, Not the Ceiling: Artists Want Respect, Not Just Licenses (Guest Column)
research.summary: Guest column arguing that opt-in licensing is minimum requirement - artists want true partnerships with AI companies, not just compensation.
